title: 第13章 夜访伯爵第14章 你管这叫重伤
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
夜晚，水晶城城主堡里
“对，现在加速生产，第一批制造完之后立刻散播出去”
卡里伯爵有些不耐烦的对着轮盘式电话开口：“别管成本了！给我去买机器，给我去招人！累死了就换人！”
说完最后一句，卡里伯爵愤怒的挂断了电话机：“一帮废物”
揉了揉眉心，卡里伯爵那有疲惫的中年脸庞浮现了些许担忧，整个人无力的躺进了沙发
他原本犹豫过是否要和那些来历不明的家伙合作，毕竟这件事实在太危险了，一旦引起异端审判局和莫森帝国的注意，至少他肯定是跑不了
但那些人给他展现的东西实在太诱人了，那不止可以让他恢复自己祖先的荣誉，甚至能让他掌控整个莫森帝国
到时候别说一个前异端审判官了，就算是莫森帝国的皇帝他也不怕
一想到这里，卡里伯爵就忍不住露出笑容，他起身来到窗前，看向了街道上往来的人流，眼中难得的流露出一丝愧疚：“一半，只要水晶城一半人的灵魂就好，不用全部的.......”
然而没等卡里伯爵那仅剩的良知让他继续自言自语，他身后已经有声音接过了他的话
“您还挺善良的呢，那可以给鸢尾花监狱多批点资金吗？卡里伯爵”
话音落下，卡里伯爵整个人如同被雷电击中一般，剧烈的颤抖了起来。眼中的慌乱与恐惧几乎将他填满
他知道声音的主人是谁，也想过他会找上门，但没想到会这么快，还是以这种形式
卡里伯爵强撑着转身，看向了自己书桌后的椅子
毫不意外，卡里伯爵看到一名俊秀的紫发青年正坐在那里，半张脸庞隐藏在阴影中，幽蓝色的眼瞳此刻正平静的看向他
在对上那双眼睛的一刻，卡里伯爵差点被吓的跪了下去，但还是硬着头皮露出了一个笑容：
“晚上好啊，狄曼列典狱长，这么晚了是有什么急事吗？”
看着不远处的卡里伯爵，狄曼列平静的敲了敲桌子，声音不带一丝感情：“您再有任何动作的话，我就送你去见你的祖先”
霎时间，卡里伯爵本来正在思考怎么通知圣骑士和守卫的思绪都生生停滞，呼吸都差点忘记
狄曼列也没有在意他的反应，只是依旧平静，伸手拈起一块茶点放进了嘴里，嚼了两下后擦了擦了手：“嗯，味道不错，伯爵大人真会享受”

“狄曼列典狱长喜欢的话，我让人送一批到鸢尾花监狱就好”
卡里伯爵一边保持着笑容一边在内心疯狂的骂人
在卡里伯爵的预估中，就算狄曼列会插手这件事，至少也会在掌握一部分证据后来找他对质，再怎么样也会先去了解他们的谋划
但卡里完全没有想到狄曼列会在第二天就找上门，并且似乎没有打算和他互相试探的意思
“不用，反正卡里伯爵你以后大概率也吃不到了”
狄曼列没给卡里伯爵说话的机会，只是自顾自的掏出了一本笔记本，将胸口的钢笔摘下后平静的划了几下：
“接下来，我问，你答”
听着狄曼列没有波动的语气，卡里伯爵整个人几乎被冷汗浸透，只能在内心祈祷有人发现这里的异常
“当然，您有什么问题，我一定知无不言”
狄曼列没有回应，轻轻敲了敲笔记本：
“第一个问题，那种作用于灵魂的成瘾药品是什么时候开始生产的？”
轰——————
卡里伯爵的脑袋炸开一道惊雷，他没想到上来就是一个重量级，双腿只能不断发颤着试图搪塞
“什，什么灵魂药品，我没听说过啊狄曼列典狱长”
狄曼列看了看强行保持笑容的卡里伯爵，很快又收回视线在笔记本上写了几个单词
“卡里伯爵，我没什么耐心，你应该知道异端审判局做事的风格，这是唯一的一次警告”
话音落下，卡里伯爵终于是承受不住压力，整个人跪伏在了地上，原本那些【你没有权利直接审问我】之类的话也被他吞了回去
content_en:
At night, in the main castle of Crystal City
"Yes, we are speeding up production now and distributing them immediately after the first batch is produced."
Earl Cary spoke to the roulette phone impatiently: "Don't worry about the cost! Buy me the machine and recruit people! Replace people when you are exhausted!"
After saying the last sentence, Count Cary hung up the phone angrily: "A bunch of trash"
Rubbing his eyebrows, Earl Cary's tired middle-aged face showed a little worry, and he lay down on the sofa feebly.
He originally hesitated whether to cooperate with those guys of unknown origin. After all, this matter was too dangerous. Once it attracted the attention of the Heresy Tribunal and the Mawson Empire, at least he would definitely not be able to escape.
But what those people showed him was too tempting. It would not only allow him to restore the honor of his ancestors, but even allow him to control the entire Mohsen Empire.
At that time, let alone a former heresy inquisitor, he will not be afraid even of the emperor of the Mohsen Empire.
When he thought of this, Count Cary couldn't help but smile. He stood up and came to the window, looking at the flow of people on the street. A rare trace of guilt showed in his eyes: "Half, as long as half of the souls of the people in Crystal City are fine, not all..."
However, before Count Cary's remaining conscience allowed him to continue talking to himself, a voice behind him had already taken over his words.
"You are quite kind. Can you give more funds to Iris Prison? Count Cary"
As soon as the words fell, Count Cary's whole body trembled violently as if he had been struck by lightning. The panic and fear in his eyes almost filled him
He knew who the owner of the voice was, and he thought he would come to his door, but he didn't expect it would be so soon, or in this form.
Count Cary forced himself to turn around and looked at the chair behind his desk.
Not surprisingly, Count Cary saw a handsome purple-haired young man sitting there, half of his face hidden in the shadows, and his blue eyes were looking at him calmly.
The moment he met those eyes, Count Cary was almost frightened and knelt down, but he still forced himself to smile:
"Good evening, Warden Diamanlie. Is there anything urgent at this late hour?"
Looking at Count Cary not far away, Diamanlie knocked on the table calmly, his voice without any emotion: "If you make any more moves, I will send you to meet your ancestors."
In an instant, Count Cary was thinking about how to inform the Paladin and the guards. His thoughts were stagnant, and he almost forgot to breathe.
Diamanlie didn't pay attention to his reaction, but remained calm. He reached out and picked up a piece of tea and put it into his mouth. After chewing it twice, he wiped his hands: "Well, it tastes good. Lord Earl really enjoys it."
"If Warden Dimanlie likes it, I can have someone send a batch to Iris Prison."
Count Cary kept smiling while cursing crazily in his heart.
In Count Cary's estimation, even if Diamanlie would intervene in this matter, he would at least confront him after getting some evidence, and no matter what, he would first understand their plan.
But Cary didn't expect that Dimanlie would come to the door the next day, and it seemed that he had no intention of testing each other with him.
"No, anyway, Count Cary, you will most likely not be able to eat it in the future."
Diamanlie did not give Count Cary a chance to speak. He just took out a notebook and took off the pen from his chest and wrote a few words calmly:
"Next, I ask and you answer"
Listening to Diamanlie's calm tone, Count Cary was almost soaked in cold sweat. He could only pray in his heart that someone would discover something unusual here.
"Of course, if you have any questions, I will tell you everything."
Diamanlie did not respond and tapped the notebook lightly:
"The first question is, when did the addictive drugs that act on the soul begin to be produced?"
Boom——————
A thunder exploded in Earl Cary's head, and heI didn’t expect that he would be a heavyweight when he came up, and his legs could only keep trembling in an attempt to stop him.
"What, what kind of soul medicine, I've never heard of it, Warden Dimanlie"
Diamanlie looked at Count Cary who was forcing a smile, then quickly withdrew his gaze and wrote a few words in his notebook.
"Count Cary, I don't have much patience. You should know the way the Inquisition works. This is the only warning."
After the words fell, Count Cary finally couldn't bear the pressure and knelt on the ground. He swallowed back his original words like "You have no right to interrogate me directly".
